target_audience.value: Viewers interested in CARDIOVASCULAR_HEALTH, HEALTHY_AGING, METABOLIC_HEALTH within the Senior Health niche, based on the combined canonical topic distribution across the benchmark channels.
target_audience.evidence: Combined canonical topic distribution across CH-000003, CH-000005: {'CARDIOVASCULAR_HEALTH': 32, 'HEALTHY_AGING': 22, 'METABOLIC_HEALTH': 7}.

positioning.value: A focused, evidence-labeled explainer channel within Senior Health -- distinct from each benchmark channel's individual presentation style, not a copy of either.

niche_boundaries.value: Senior Health content bounded to the core content pillars observed across benchmark channels (CARDIOVASCULAR_HEALTH, HEALTHY_AGING, METABOLIC_HEALTH); claims requiring domain expertise (medical, financial, legal, or otherwise) are never presented as verified fact from competitor transcripts without EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.
niche_boundaries.evidence: This repository never treats competitor/creator transcript claims as verified domain fact; see guardrails.no_causal_claims_from_public_correlation.

robust_cross_channel_patterns.claim: Leading a hook with a concrete number increases relative performance.

channel_specific_patterns_to_avoid_copyi.claim: Calculated-escalation script structure increases relative performance.
channel_specific_patterns_to_avoid_copyi.note: significant in only one benchmark channel -- do not generalize

title_language.value: Prefer WARNING_OR_RISK and NUMBERED_SPECIFICITY structures where a channel's own evidence supports them; do not assume either transfers to a new channel with zero data.

thumbnail_language.value: NOT_AVAILABLE for CH-000003, CH-000005 (THUMBNAIL_REFERENCE_GAP); where thumbnail evidence exists for a benchmark channel, favor bright/natural colors, bold fonts, one big idea per the Packaging SOP.

hook_principles.value: Robust cross-channel hook pattern(s) for this benchmark set: NUMBER_LED; use as a diagnostic lens, do not assume it outperforms until the new channel has >=3 items in that archetype.

script_structures.value: No script archetype reached ROBUST_CROSS_CHANNEL_PATTERN for this benchmark set; use BUT/THEREFORE causal structuring as a general baseline discipline, not a proven differentiator for this niche.

format_strategy.value: Observed format mix across benchmark channels: {'LONG_FORM': 61}; match the dominant observed format and do not add a second format on the same channel without an explicit test, per the unresolved Shorts-vs-long-form platform claim (TR-018-CLM-018).

differentiation.value: Make one explicit, consistently-kept audience promise per TR-018-REC-004 rather than replicating either benchmark channel's topic mix wholesale.
